inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Read displayed result identity, settings and bounded frame/mode metadata. Results carrying validated saved time-history snapshotInfo also add a detached snapshotStorage summary {requested,count,bytes,budgetBytes,unit:"byte",bytesPerScalar:8,meaning:"stored-scalar-values-only",excludes:[objects,rendering,observations,receiver-traces,peak-memory],warningCount}; it is derived from validateHistoryMetadata, omits per-frame steps and warning texts, never contains physical arrays, and legacy results without snapshotInfo omit it.
limitations: Argument envelope only; runtime validation remains authoritative.
